verdict.rationale: Washington ESD is a state government agency whose employer portal handles unemployment tax filing, quarterly reports and benefits administration. User-authored automations that can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back are outside this kind of product, so the story is a category error. Amended quarterly reports are a filing correction, not automation versioning, and are not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
